scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the match of agent's reported values against paper-sourced gold constants with tolerances; the raw artifacts (band structure, DFT energies) are not submitted, so result-level compare is used, but scoring is deterministic from reported numbers.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported value: 1.06 eV (direct bandgap of GeSe monolayer)
Paper claims 'four-fold enhancement' which corresponds to a ratio >3.5
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper claim; threshold set to 3.5 to allow tolerance while still confirming substantial enhancement.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Paper states the enhancement factor; a real reproduction must reach at least a ratio of 3.5 to be considered a reproduction of the four-fold claim.

outputs.description: Electronic bandgap of the pristine GeSe monolayer. The checker compares the value against the paper-reported bandgap within a tolerance.
Adsorption energy of pyrene on the 4×4 GeSe monolayer. The checker compares the value against the paper-reported adsorption energy within a tolerance.
Thermoelectric power factor enhancement ratio (PF_GQD@GeSe / PF_GeSe) at 300 K. Full credit is awarded if the ratio is at least the paper-reported threshold (≥3.5).

output_contract.notes: The checker extracts the bandgap and adsorption energy for exact-match scoring within hidden tolerances. The power factor enhancement ratio is scored as threshold_or_better, so better-than-paper performance is not penalized. All other fields in the power factor output are for audit and documentation; only the ratio and its meeting of the threshold carry the main weight.

steps.description: Check GeSe monolayer bandgap against paper's 1.06 eV ±0.2 eV
Check adsorption energy against paper's -0.92 eV ±0.15 eV
Check power factor enhancement ratio is at least 3.5 (four-fold enhancement)
